metadata.description: 58 skills, 20 agents, and 3 team workflows for software engineering: knowledge, tools, playbooks, frameworks, AI engineering, and agents, plus the loop-virtuoso Claude Code plugin

plugins.name: knowledge-virtuoso
plugins.description: 17 knowledge skills: design patterns, refactoring, SOLID, debugging, clean architecture, testing, API design, security, agent security, context engineering, docs lookup, scrum, performance, microservices, CI/CD, accessibility, and database design

plugins.name: tools-virtuoso
plugins.description: 13 tool skills: rules writer, ticket writer, agent creator, skill writer, plugin creator, research, brainstorming, ecosystem advisor, PR message writer, report writer, stakeholder update writer, web screenshot, and image annotate

plugins.name: playbooks-virtuoso
plugins.description: 8 playbook skills: ticket delivery, spec-driven development, TDD, branch finishing, PR feedback, handoff, worktree ops, and hooks and guardrails

plugins.name: frameworks-virtuoso
plugins.description: 7 framework skills: Symfony components and upgrade, Django components, LangChain components, PHP upgrade, Composer dependencies, and Vercel AI SDK

plugins.name: ai-virtuoso
plugins.description: 4 AI engineering skills: agent design, LLM evals, LLM observability, and MCP server development

plugins.name: agents-virtuoso
plugins.description: 20 agents (specialists and roles), 3 team workflows, and the agent-orchestration and verification skills, plus headless wrapper skills for CI review, test gaps, migration planning, dependency audit, and refactor scans

plugins.name: loop-virtuoso
plugins.description: Claude Code only. A backlog-driven delivery loop that feeds the agent one small item at a time and accepts it only when verify commands pass and a write-boundary guard approves. Ships hooks, scripts, commands, and 2 skills
